title: Toledo Xignex Trojans nab back-to-back wins to stay at No. 2 in PCAP

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The Toledo Xignex Trojans scored two convincing victories to strengthen their hold on second place in the Omega Division of the Professional Chess Association of the Philippines (PCAP) Wesley So Cup on Thursday night, November 5. The Trojans first routed the Cavite Spartans, 14.5-6.5, before completing their double-header sweep with a 14-7 victory over the Cagayan Kings. Against Cavite, Toledo suffered a 4.5-2.5 defeat in the blitz round, with debutants Paul Sanchez and Grandmaster (GM) Rogelio Barcenilla Jr. providing the team’s only wins against Renie Malupa and Jayson Visca, respectively, on the first two boards.
